editorial.blurb: Giordano's is the real deal for Chicago deep-dish pizza—a stuffed masterpiece with golden crust, layers of cheese, and bright tomato sauce that lives up to the hype.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a medium pizza instead of large (they're massive and meant to feed 4-6), and plan for a 45-minute wait from order to table; use that time to enjoy the walls covered in memorabilia while your pie bakes.
